description: #791 changed config entities: YAML list items resolved by id/name (own line, later in the block, or a sibling below), block keys, &anchors, comments and document markers, too-generic names (runs-on, pull_request) skipped outward; JSON objects by id/name and container keys; TOML [[array]] ids and dotted [table] headers; plus env names inside config. Lockfiles, test paths and generated directories are not scanned.
